One of the new Western cozy cafes in this nice neighborhood
Nov 2025 • Family
Checking it out after reading good reviews...

Atmosphere:
We liked the lounge seats along the back walls with the top-hung roof windows letting some sun/moonlight in. The second floor indoor area is small with just four small tables, but good effort in making those mostly Korean/ some English books available. Second floor's outdoor area might be nice when the weather's good.

Products:
Some fragrances and spa products available near the counter. Up its chill vibe?

Food:
The menu's quite a fun mix - we tried Sirloin Steak, Spicy squid pasta, Shrimp Quinoa Salad, Gnocchi, Salmon Benedict, Tacos, and their signature breakfast (a little measly-looking with the halved sausage and slice of spam), and some matcha and avocado smoothies. Overall, the main strength was that it was fun to taste many different types of dishes at one place, the taste was kinda alright for this price point.

Location:
Quaint vibes on this up-and-coming stretch of restaurants in this neighborhood. Not exactly facing, but close enough to hop over to both Canh Vien park or MidTown's river for a nice evening stroll. Couple hundred meters to the Japanese, Taiwanese and Korean international schools so probably students/parents/families in the 'hood can patronize easily too.

The Brunch You’ll Keep Dreaming About: Laluna Cafe’s Salmon Benedict Steals the Show
Oct 2025 • Family
The vibe hits you the moment you walk in — airy, warm lighting, soft playlists that make you want to linger just a little longer. The staff are friendly in that natural, not-trying-too-hard way, and the service is smooth even during busy hours.

Now, let’s talk about the Salmon Benedict — easily the star of the menu.
Perfectly poached eggs that break into a silky yolk over buttery smoked salmon and toasted sourdough, finished with a light, tangy hollandaise that somehow doesn’t make you feel heavy afterward. Every bite tastes like someone actually cared about getting it just right. Would totally come back — and bring friends next time.
